native_behavior: Resolve the active layout slot through the native window-layout key routine.
On first use, initialize button rectangles from that slot's linked list, mark the slot initialized, and return zero.
Return zero when no button was hit.
When the native highlight mode is active, set the six-by-six clip, selected-button fields, actor-panel highlight, and rectangle highlight; return the one-based button index.

project_search.decision: Translated from REA and composed with the clean 0x004D5D70 window-key and 0x004D66F0 layout-node owners.

implementation.render_callbacks: Typed operations receive clip, actor-panel highlight, and highlight rectangle requests.

limitations: button_count is unused by the native routine, and button_index must be a valid one-based result when nonzero.
Renderer operations are explicit typed endpoints; the native frame/menu dispatcher remains unmigrated.
No game process or behavioral test was run.
